sentences.text: South Korea's distinctive role in the Allied Industrial Base is as its battery maker and equipment builder.
It holds 51% of world exports or production of cathode materials and precursors.
It is the largest allied holder of battery components and of gas turbines and LNG plant, and it is the best-placed trusted partner of 56 economies for at least one step.
Nationally, that strength reads Preserve in battery cells, EV drivetrains and vehicles, reactors and gas plant.

In battery components and materials it reads only Catch Up: South Korea is the largest allied holder of components and a leading cathode supplier, but its national position sits below the top quarter of producers.
Its exposure lies at the start of the chain.
It is among the most import-dependent economies for oil, gas and coal, relies on China for refined rare earths, and buys 49% of its imported uranium conversion and enrichment from Russia.
For minerals, rare-earth and wind materials and grid components it should depend deliberately on trusted producers.
At home, the energy system needs nuclear, solar and wind power and electric vehicles faster.
Its development cooperation can follow its firms' investment abroad, helping partners add trusted battery and drivetrain capacity.

Imported oil, gas and coal; the rare-earth chain from separation to magnets, where China holds 94% of world refining supply and trusted suppliers only 4%; uranium conversion and enrichment; and the control software of grids, batteries and inverters.
The answer is trusted contracts, stocks and control of command paths, not self-sufficiency.
Preserve battery cells and packs, EV drivetrains and vehicles, reactors and nuclear fuel parts, and gas turbines and LNG plant.

at deployment, Accelerate where deployment need reaches 60;
